method.timing: PoB code to JSON result. Includes code inflation for both engines (Rust for PoBR; Node zlib before pob-web XML import), adapter validation and Node Worker transport for pob-web. Harness JSON validation outside samples. Alternating engine order; unique PoBR request strings bypass the response cache.
method.initialization: One observed initialization per engine, including ES module import I/O, from preloaded WASM/data bytes. Excludes reference worker creation and artifact reads/hash checks. Not a startup distribution or network measurement.
method.limitations: Different engine implementations, output contracts and game-data/feature coverage. pob-web also constructs headless UI state during import. No browser rendering or browser Worker transport, download time, incremental editing or runtime memory comparison.
